Steel self-weight uses the girder material density

Deflection in design check = deflection shown per girder
Thermal load case exists (it is used in combinations)
Cross-bracing spacing used = Additional Input spacing
Girder area in analysis/self-weight = area in design check
Number of girder self-weight lines = number of girders
